articles.summary: Expands distribution network in Florida COVINGTON, La., Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Pool Corporation (Nasdaq: POOL) announced today that it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Team Horner Group, Inc. (“Team Horner”), a Fort Lauderdale, Florida-based wholesale distributor of swimming pool products with sales centers primarily in Florida. Team Horner’s wholesale distribution business, which operates as HornerXpress, provides a broad range of swimming pool equipment, chemicals, supplies and related products to pool contractors, builders, dealers and other specialty customers. HornerXpress operates 18 sales centers, 17 in Florida and one in New York. “We are excited for Team Horner to join POOLCORP,” said John B. Watwood, POOLCORP president and chief executive officer. “Team Horner has built a strong reputation for delivering best-in-class customer service, sharing industry expertise and developing longstanding customer and supplier relationships. The addition of its distribution business will add greater efficiency to the customer experience through enhanced proximity, scale and product availability. Team Horner’s employees are the foundation of this great business, and we look forward to welcoming them to POOLCORP.” “Team Horner’s success has always been driven by our commitment to our customers, employees and supplier partners,” said Mike Dooley, Team Horner president and chief […]
articles.title: Pool Corporation to Acquire Team Horner

articles.summary: COVINGTON, La., Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Pool Corporation (Nasdaq: POOL) announced today that it will participate in the following investor events in November 2026: November 10, 2026 – Baird 2026 Global Industrial Conference November 17, 2026 – Stephens Annual Investment Conference Investor-related materials and company information are available on the Investor Relations section of POOLCORP’s website. Pool Corporation is the world’s largest wholesale distributor of swimming pool and related backyard products. POOLCORP operates approximately 455 sales centers in North America, Europe and Australia through which it distributes more than 200,000 products to roughly 125,000 wholesale customers. For more information about POOLCORP, please visit www.poolcorp.com. CONTACT: Kristin S. ByarsDirector, Investor Relations and Finance 985.801.5153kristin.byars@poolcorp.com
articles.title: Pool Corporation Announces Upcoming Investor Conference Participation
